Ruling: batch #160 item 4 · letter B (the `if (label)` divider gate is untouched; a section member that carries a `description` but no `name` / `label` gets a blurb-only rendering path in the grouped layout — no predicate line, no collapse pair — so all five layout arms render the blurb) · maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-18T11:59Z

Director seat, summon #24, `session_01Wj1HUjzyeiBQ8atRf1ZhaL`. Presented in detail with the recommendation **B**; the maintainer agreed. Facts (this card; triage 5727293023): the grouped layout opens the divider row on `if (label)`; the same condition carries the ADR-0089 `visibleWhen` line, objectui#6236's membership assertion and the 「an untitled bucket is never collapsible」 pair; split / modal / wizard / tabbed render the blurb for a description-only member, grouped drops it; PR objectui#9833 pinned the boundary on purpose.

## Ruling — B

- Grouped layout: a member with `description` and no title renders its blurb through a path that carries nothing else — ⛔ no `visibleWhen` gating of the group, ⛔ no collapse — matching what the other four arms show. The `if (label)` gate and its three riders are unchanged.
- The pin PR objectui#9833 added flips to assert the blurb is rendered (and that no divider, no collapse control and no predicate line appear for such a member).
- ⛔ **A** rewrites three keys' semantics to fix a blurb; ⛔ **C** leaves one arm inconsistent with four.

Four-facet reading: ① one inconsistency removed without touching three declared semantics; ② a description-only section is an ordinary text block in form builders; ③ five arms agree, an AI author's metadata renders the same everywhere; ④ nothing declared.

## Execution

`needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `domain:spec`, `priority:p2` stay (lands in objectui's plugin-form). `Clause-②: no`.

- **动作面** — `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` was rewritten by objectui#9948 minutes ago (83979 → 87392 bytes), so **every line number on this card had to be re-derived**. The `if (label)` divider gate is now at **`:1496`**, ⛔ no longer the `:1438`–`:1467` the card and ruling cite. The premise is intact and the code says so itself at `:1512`: 「a member carrying a `description` and NEITHER `name` nor `label` still draws no divider and still drops its blurb; that shape is pinned as behaviour … and handed back as a finding, ⛔ not decided here」.
- **卡引用面** — objectui#9833 is MERGED; its pin lives in `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/objectFormSectionMembers-8071.test.tsx` (it also moved one ledger line, which this card should ⛔ not need to). objectui#9779 landed. objectui#9834 (drawer arm) remains a separate card.
- **工作项面** — `ObjectForm.tsx` is **FREE**: the chain holder objectui#9948 merged at 20:14Z and was released at 20:15Z.

✔ `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` — FREE, held by no open PR.
⛔ `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` — **HELD** by open PR objectui#9924 (slice 17, parked on row C8). objectui#9833 moved one line in it, so the order **fences it explicitly**: a behaviour flip should not move the ledger's counts, and if the dev finds it must, it **stops and hands back** rather than editing a held file.

The dev ran four ablations; one is load-bearing beyond the usual. Widening the heading gate to **letter A — the shape the maintainer REFUSED** — reds rows **8** and **9** while row 7 stays green: row 8 on 「expected 1 to be +0」 (a collapse control appeared for an untitled member) and row 9 on 「expected [] to deeply equal [ 'amount' ]」 (the untitled member's predicate gated its whole group).

⇒ the pins do not merely assert that the blurb renders; they **catch the rejected design specifically**, and row 7 alone could not tell the two apart. ⭐ That is the difference between pinning an outcome and pinning a decision — a later seat that reaches for A gets a red naming exactly why.

- The blurb-only row uses the pseudo-field name `__section_blurb_…`, deliberately distinct from the heading row's `__section_…`. An internal runtime spelling, ⛔ not an authorable or published key — which is why clause ② stays `no`.
